weather.d: Endless sunflower hills under a bright summer sky: drifting clouds, a turning windmill and birds.
A huge striped anime sun sinks behind cherry trees and a pagoda while petals drift by.
A golden sun melts into a rolling sea: waves, glittering light, gulls and a lighthouse.
A rainy neon city skyline at night with flickering signs and flying car lights. Brings real rain (your crops love it).
Dancing aurora ribbons over snowy peaks and pine forests, with twinkling stars and shooting stars.

seeds.d: Crop. Grows in about 40 s (twice as fast when watered). Harvest when ripe: time it with the golden ring for a perfect harvest.
Crop. A berry bush that ripens in about a minute and gives several sweet strawberries.
Crop. Fast golden wheat: ready in about 30 s.
Crop. A slow vine that grows one big, valuable pumpkin.
Crop. A glowing night melon. Slow, but worth a lot of gems at the market.
